title: Cross-model drift audit and regression harness for INT8 weight-only profiles (GPTQ/AWQ)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: As we roll out INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ/AWQ) across the model catalog, we've seen intermittent accuracy regressions that only surface after extended traffic patterns or when models are exercised under varying prompt distributions. This ticket scopes and implements a cross-model regression and drift-audit harness that combines calibration replay, longitudinal evaluation, and automated alerting to catch subtle quality regressions introduced by profile changes or calibration parameter drift.

Goals: 1) Provide an automated regression pipeline that runs nightly and on PRs touching quantization profiles, comparing new profiles against pinned baselines across representative workloads. 2) Surface model-specific drift metrics (delta-accuracy, percentile token-logprob shift, top-k prediction divergence) and aggregate alerts when regressions exceed adaptive thresholds. 3) Integrate with CI gates so that PRs that change GPTQ/AWQ calibration constants fail fast with actionable diagnostics and suggested rollbacks.

Scope: - Integration harness that runs on CI and nightly runners for a curated model set (small/med/large) and representative prompt suites (chat, summarization, code). - Calibration replay: re-run calibration micro-batches using the same seed/ordering to detect non-deterministic calibration regressions. - Cross-model baseline comparison with stored golden outputs and token-level diffs. - Drift detection metrics and time-series retention for 30 days. - Automated triage outputs: minimal repro prompts, top-k token divergence examples, and suggested thresholds for canary release policies.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly pipeline executes for curated models and stores per-run artifacts (calibration logs, generated outputs, token-level diffs) in artifact storage with retention policy
PR CI job runs a fast subset and fails when delta-accuracy or token-logprob shifts exceed configured thresholds
Dashboard exposes drift metrics (delta-accuracy, KL divergence of token distributions, 95th percentile latency/throughput for INT8 profiles) with 30d retention
Alerting rule created: regression alert when any model's measured quality drop exceeds historical baseline + adaptive margin for 3 consecutive runs
Playbook documented for investigating CI failures and performing rapid rollback of quantization profile changes
test_matrix: Quant modes: GPTQ-int8 weight-only, AWQ-int8 weight-only, FP8 baseline (control)
Workloads: chat-dialogue prompts (50), summarization (40), code-completion (30), meme/edge-cases (20)
Runs: PR-fast (subset), nightly-long (full matrix with 3 seeds), canary-run (on Dedicated only)
implementation_steps: Design storage schema for per-run artifacts and define minimal repro artifact bundle (config, seed, prefix-cache state)
Implement CI job (ci/quant/regtest-fast) that runs subset of prompts and computes quality deltas vs pinned baseline
Build nightly job (nightly/quant/drift-audit) that runs full matrix and pushes metrics to observability stack
Add token-level diff tooling and a small web UI to browse minimal repros and highlighted divergence points
Create alerting rules and link to run artifacts in alert messages
Document playbook and add to runbook repository (confluence link below)
security_considerations: Artifacts will contain prompt examples which may include customer-inspired text. Nightly runs must scrub customer-identifiable tokens and mark artifacts as internal. Ensure access control on artifact storage and dashboard links matches Dedicated/private tenancy restrictions.
notes_and_updates: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after post-release investigation showed a 1.8% drop on med-beta for summarization workloads when switching to AWQ profile

2026-03-11 - Jonah Kim: Spike complete. Fast CI job prototype implemented using 10 prompts and token-diff output. Observed non-deterministic drift due to calibration ordering in AWQ; need deterministic calibration replay
2026-03-12 - Data: Added threshold proposal based on historical variance: fail PR if delta-accuracy > max(0.5%, historical_std*3) or median token-logprob shift > 0.12
2026-03-12 - PM sync: Agreed on models for nightly run and 30d retention. PM asks for canary run on Dedicated only before production rollout.
Open questions: How to represent adaptive thresholds across model sizes? Should we weight prompt families differently based on business criticality?
playbook: Investigation checklist: 1) Re-run CI job with same seed and full prompt set. 2) Compare calibration logs to detect parameter divergence. 3) If non-determinism found, run calibration with fixed ordering and log checksum. 4) Re-evaluate AWQ vs GPTQ per-prompt regressions and escalate to research team if regression isolated to AWQ math kernels. 5) If regression persists, trigger rollback of profile in canary and open hotfix PR to revert calibration constants.
rollback_plan: Tag affected profiles as 'blocked' in model-catalog. Canary traffic routed to FP8 or previous INT8 pinned profile. Create rollback PR that reverts profile file and trigger full regression suite. Notify on-call and product owner.
